sections.indications_and_usage: INDICATIONS For symptoms of thyroid metabolism, goiter, immune system TPO, inflammation of the thyroid.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions: Adults: Chronic: 5 drops 2 times daily, morning and early afternoon, on an empty stomach. Acute: 5 drops 3 or 4 times daily. Consult a physician for use in children under 12 years of age.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: WARNINGS: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Do not use if tamper evident seal is broken or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.
